Output contract:
- Respond with a single JSON array and nothing else - no prose, no markdown fences.
- Each array item is an object with keys "skill" (canonical name, string), "seniority_level"
  (canonical level, string) and "experience_years" (integer, your best estimate).
- For a job_posting document, also include "required" (boolean): true when the posting
  lists the skill as mandatory, false when it's optional/nice-to-have. Omit "required"
  entirely for a resume document.
- If the document has no technical skills, return an empty array: []
user_prompt:
Document type: resume

Extract every technical skill from the document below and respond with a JSON array only, following the output contract from your instructions.

--- DOCUMENT START ---
ALEXANDER WRIGHT
Principal Systems Engineer · Solutions Architect · Cloud Native & AI Specialist · Data Engineer

CONTACT INFORMATION

Mobile: (+1) 555 902 4567

Location: Toronto, ON, Canada

Email: a.wright.tech@email.com

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/alexwright-tech-profile

GitHub: https://github.com/alexwright-dev

PROFESSIONAL OVERVIEW
With ~18 years of experience in the technology sector, I have led cross-functional teams delivering cloud-native, highly scalable, and AI-driven solutions adopted by global enterprises. I consistently improve system resilience, time-to-market, and user engagement by applying modern architectural paradigms, microservices, domain-driven design, and multi-cloud strategies. My expertise spans technical leadership, full-stack engineering, and advanced DevSecOps practices. I bring strong capabilities in data streaming, generative AI, and machine learning, leveraging large language models (LLMs), real-time telemetry, and predictive analytics to enhance enterprise platforms. Recognized for strategic vision, seamless cross-team communication, and adaptability, I am committed to mentoring engineering teams and driving future-ready architectures that generate measurable business value.

ROLES

Principal Solutions Architect

Lead Cloud & Platform Engineer

Senior AI & Data Architect

Technical Tech Lead

SOLUTIONS & EXPERTISE

Distributed Systems & Architecture (Microservices, Event-Driven, Serverless, CQRS, Domain-Driven Design)

Multi-Cloud Infrastructure & Migrations (AWS, Azure, Kubernetes ecosystem)

AI Integrations & Generative AI (LLMs, RAG Architectures, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI)

Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling (Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision)

High-Volume Data Engineering & Streaming (Apache Flink, Kafka, Real-time analytics)

DevSecOps & CI/CD Automation (GitLab CI, Terraform, ArgoCD)

Infrastructure as Code & Container Orchestration

Advanced Observability, Performance Tuning, and Chaos Engineering

INDUSTRIES

Healthcare & Life Sciences (telemedicine, patient data security, AI diagnostics)

FinTech & Trading (fraud detection, real-time transaction processing)

Telecommunications (IoT telemetry, network event processing)

Renewable Energy (smart grid analytics, asset management)

E-learning & EdTech (adaptive learning algorithms, platform scaling)

TECHNOLOGIES

Architectures & Paradigms: Microservices, Event-Driven, CQRS, Event Sourcing, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Serverless, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, SOLID Principles, Twelve-Factor App, Chaos Engineering.

AI Engineering & Machine Learning: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI APIs, OpenCV, NLP pipelines, RAG implementations, Vector Databases (Pinecone, Milvus).

Data Engineering: Apache Flink, Apache Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Kafka, Airflow, Elasticsearch, Data Modeling.

Backend: Go (Golang), Rust, Java (Spring Boot), Python (FastAPI, Django), Node.js (NestJS), C#/.NET Core.

Frontend: Vue.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, WebAssembly (Wasm), RxJS.

Cloud Platforms: AWS (EKS, S3, RDS, Lambda, SageMaker, DynamoDB), Microsoft Azure (AKS, Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, Key Vault).

DevSecOps & Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, SonarQube, HashiCorp Vault.

Databases: PostgreSQL, Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j (GraphDB), SQL Server.

Testing & QA: PyTest, JUnit, Jest, Cypress, Testcontainers, K6 (Load Testing), Contract Testing.

SOFT SKILLS

Strategic Leadership & Technical Mentorship

Cross-functional Communication & Stakeholder Management

Agile & Lean Delivery Mindset

Complex Problem Solving & Critical Thinking

Conflict Resolution & Negotiation

Continuous Learning & High Adaptability

PROFESSIONAL TRAINING / CERTIFICATIONS

AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional

Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

DeepLearning.AI TensorFlow Developer Professional Certificate

LANGUAGES

English (Native)

French (C1 - Advanced)

German (B2 - Upper Intermediate)

PROFESSIONAL AND BUSINESS EXPERIENCE

Global IT Consulting Corp. — Lead AI & Cloud Architect
Aug 2024 – Present
Client: MediCare Global Solutions

Architected and delivered AI-powered diagnostic and search solutions using RAG pipelines, LLMs, and vector databases, drastically improving medical record retrieval accuracy.

Built real-time streaming pipelines with Apache Flink and Kafka to process patient telemetry data, ensuring zero data loss with robust DLQ handling and idempotency.

Developed high-performance microservices using Go and Python (FastAPI), enforcing strict healthcare compliance and data governance standards.

Migrated legacy workloads to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), authored Terraform scripts, and modernized CI/CD pipelines via GitLab CI, reducing deployment times by 40%.

Mentored junior and mid-level engineers, leading Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) and conducting rigorous code reviews.

Global IT Consulting Corp. — Sr. Platform Engineer
Jun 2020 – Mar 2024
Client: AeroLogistics & IoT Dynamics

Designed and built scalable backend systems for global fleet geolocation and IoT event-processing platforms capable of handling millions of concurrent events.

Delivered asynchronous microservices (Rust/Node.js) and intuitive control panels (Vue.js/TypeScript).

Established a comprehensive testing strategy (unit, contract, E2E) and automated infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and ArgoCD on AWS.

Integrated Auth0, multi-tenancy controls, and established event-driven flows with Kafka, significantly improving system security and operational automation.

Applied advanced concurrency models and memory-safe programming to eliminate latency bottlenecks.

NextGen Software Studio — Sr. Full-Stack Developer
Jul 2016 – Mar 2020
Client: CloudCRM Inc.

Co-defined the engineering department's cross-functional quality strategy, establishing CI/CD standards and code coverage minimums across 5+ teams.

Designed and delivered resilient REST and GraphQL APIs (Node.js/TypeScript) alongside highly interactive frontend applications (React).

Automated build and deployment pipelines, heavily reducing manual overhead and release cycle times.

Managed and scaled distributed databases, smoothly transitioning monolithic data structures into scalable PostgreSQL and Cassandra clusters.

EduTech Solutions — Software Developer
March 2015 - July 2016
Clients: FinTrust Bank / SmartLearn EdTech

Delivered backend services for nationwide e-learning platforms utilized in government modernization programs.

Built secure banking applications with C#/.NET Core, implementing asymmetric cryptography protocols for digital onboarding and biometric authentication.

Ensured strict software quality and financial compliance via unit, API, and E2E tests, deploying solutions across highly available environments.

Enterprise Systems Ltd. — Lead Developer
October 2011 – June 2016
Clients: AgriChain Systems / AutoParts Network

Led the end-to-end development of enterprise resource planning modules, focusing on procurement, invoicing, and inventory tracking.

Directed technical strategy, modeled databases (SQL Server), and delivered robust Java (Spring Framework) APIs and ETL processes.

Built monolithic frontend interfaces and subsequently led the initiative to decouple them using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Implemented automated testing and staging deployments, elevating system uptime and reliability for critical supply chain operations.

Financial Tech Partners — Jr. Developer
Feb 2008 – Oct 2011
Client: National Retail Federation

Engineered core modules for a high-volume debt-collection platform featuring automated dialing algorithms and intelligent agent routing.

Developed backend logic utilizing Java EJB and PHP, managing complex database transactions in Oracle.

Gained foundational experience in concurrent programming, system maintenance, and delivering secure solutions in high-pressure financial environments.
